title: 2840. Check if Strings Can be Made Equal With Operations II

examples.explanation: We can apply the following operations on s1: - Choose the indices i = 0, j = 2. The resulting string is s1 = "cbadba". - Choose the indices i = 2, j = 4. The resulting string is s1 = "cbbdaa". - Choose the indices i = 1, j = 5. The resulting string is s1 = "cabdab" = s2.
It is not possible to make the two strings equal.
